name: hh-meanrev-micro: triple-confirm reversal with range-position extreme (15m)
rationale: MECHANISM: strengthens the double-confirm by adding a THIRD, structurally-distinct overextension read — range_position (where price sits inside its recent high-low range) must be pinned at the extreme low. bb_z measures dispersion from a moving mean, rsi measures momentum exhaustion, and range_position measures location within the raw range; a genuine spent washout registers on ALL THREE, whereas a trend-day false positive typically clears only one or two. The economic claim is that requiring three independent gauges to agree buys higher per-trade quality (fewer, cleaner forced-flow overshoots) — trade count does not matter, net-per-trade does. Entry: bb_z floor AND rsi floor AND range_position floor simultaneously. Long-only spot; exit on bb_z reversion. DISCONFIRMER: ablate the third gauge — if triple-confirm is NOT better than the double-confirm (bb_z+rsi) alone, range_position is collinear with them at extremes and adds only overfitting surface — kill. If the stricter conjunction fires so rarely that effective-N collapses and the gate rejects it, that is the correct verdict, not a cue to widen the floors.
catalyst: band, momentum and range-location extremes all agree on a spent washout
